question: What is AKGEC?
answer: AKGEC stands for Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College. It is a premier engineering institution located in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. The college was established in 1998 and offers B.Tech courses in all major disciplines of Engineering, M.Tech in four branches, and MCA.

question: Where is AKGEC located?
answer: AKGEC is located at 27th KM Milestone, Delhi-Meerut Expressway, P.O. Adhyatmik Nagar, Ghaziabad - 201015, Uttar Pradesh, India.

question: When was AKGEC established?
answer: AKGEC was established in 1998.

question: What courses does AKGEC offer?
answer: AKGEC offers a four-year undergraduate B.Tech course in all major engineering branches, a two-year postgraduate M.Tech course in four engineering branches (ECE, CSE, EEE, ME), and a two-year postgraduate MCA course.

question: What departments does AKGEC have?
answer: AKGEC has the following departments: Applied Sciences and Humanities, Civil Engineering (CE), Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Information Technology (IT), Mechanical Engineering (ME), Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, and Master of Computer Applications (MCA).

question: What are the branches available at AKGEC?
answer: The branches available at AKGEC are: CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, ME, CE, Environmental Engineering (EN), Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, and MCA.

question: What is the fee structure at AKGEC?
answer: The fee structure at AKGEC varies by branch. For existing students and new students the fee structures are different. For the most accurate and updated fee details, please visit https://www.akgec.ac.in/academic-fee/ or contact the admissions office directly.

question: Does AKGEC offer scholarships?
answer: Yes, AKGEC offers scholarships for students securing an AIR up to 25000 in JEE for B.Tech admission, and AIR between 1 and 750 in CUET PG for MCA admission. From 2nd year onwards, scholarship is subject to attendance above 90% and CGPA above 7.5 with no carry-over papers. Visit https://www.akgec.ac.in/scholarship/ for details.

question: What is the admission process at AKGEC?
answer: Admission to AKGEC is done through UPTAC counselling based on JEE Main scores for B.Tech. Candidates must apply through the UP state counselling process. Visit https://admissions.akgec.ac.in/ or https://www.akgec.ac.in/courses-offered/ for details.

question: What is the placement record of AKGEC?
answer: AKGEC has an excellent placement record with top companies visiting the campus every year. The placement cell focuses on each student to maximize career prospects. Visit https://www.akgec.ac.in/placements/ for details.

question: Which companies visit AKGEC for placements?
answer: Top recruiters at AKGEC include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Accenture, Cognizant, IBM, Amazon, Adobe, and many other MNCs and startups. Visit https://www.akgec.ac.in/our-recruiters/ for a full list.

question: What is the highest package at AKGEC?
answer: AKGEC students have received competitive packages from top companies. For the latest placement highlights and highest packages, visit https://www.akgec.ac.in/placements/highlights/

question: Does AKGEC have a CSE department?
answer: Yes, AKGEC has a strong Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) department offering BTech in CSE. Visit https://www.akgec.ac.in/departments/cse/ for more details.

question: Does AKGEC have a hostel?
answer: Yes, AKGEC provides well-furnished hostel accommodation. There are six campus hostels spread over four complexes: Junior Girls Hostel Complex, Girls Hostel Complex, Junior Boys Hostel Complex, and Senior Boys Hostel Complex. Girls hostels accommodate about 600 students, Junior Boys Hostel about 300 students, and Senior Boys Hostel about 600 students. Each hostel has a mess, gymnasium, indoor and outdoor sports facilities, TV room, library, canteen, and solar water heating systems.

question: What facilities are available in AKGEC hostels?
answer: AKGEC hostels provide furnished rooms with curtains, mattress, pillow, and bed sheets. Each hostel has a separate mess with well-equipped kitchen, gymnasium, indoor and outdoor sports facilities, TV room, library with magazines and fiction books, eco-friendly solar water heating systems, canteens, and provision stores.

question: What clubs and societies are there at AKGEC?
answer: AKGEC has departmental societies (Conatus, Nirmaan, Oorja, Phoenix, Samveg), extra-curricular societies (Euphony, Footprints, Horizon, Goonj, Renaissance, Taal, Verve, Photography and Media Club, Sports Club), student chapters (CSI, Indian Concrete Institute, Robotics Club, IEEE, ISTE, SAE India), and technical clubs (Electronics Club, Communication Club).

question: Is AKGEC affiliated to any university?
answer: Yes, AKGEC is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, vide AKTU letter no. AKTU/RO/AS/2024/3319 dated 26-July-2024 for the academic year 2024-25 to 2026-27.

question: Is AKGEC accredited?
answer: Yes, AKGEC is the only engineering college in Uttar Pradesh (AKTU) accredited by NAAC with the highest grading of A++. It is also approved by AICTE and accredited by NBA for five B.Tech branches: CSE, ECE, EN, IT, and ME.

question: What is AKGEC NAAC grade?

question: Which branches are NBA accredited at AKGEC?

Note that M.Tech, MCA, Civil Engineering, and newly introduced branches like CS, CSIT, CS Data Science, CS AI&ML, AI&ML, and CS Hindi are not accredited.

question: Who is the director of AKGEC?
answer: The Director of AKGEC is Dr. Hemant Ahuja. He has over 22 years of experience in academia and industry. He graduated in Electrical Engineering from Kurukshetra University in 2001, completed M.Tech from IIT Delhi in 2008 (receiving the Prof. O.P. Gupta Gold Medal), and earned a PhD from IIT Delhi in 2013. His expertise is in Electrical Machines, Power Electronics, and Wind Energy Conversion Systems, with 50+ publications and several patents.

question: Who is the advisor of AKGEC?
answer: The Advisor of AKGEC is Prof. Amita Dev, a distinguished academician with over 40 years of experience. She has a PhD in Computer Engineering and has held roles including Vice Chancellor of IGDTUW and DSEU. Her research spans AI, Deep Neural Networks, and NLP. She has authored over 140 research publications, holds 31 patents (20 granted), and has led projects worth over Rs. 34 Crores.

question: What is the library at AKGEC?
answer: AKGEC has a Central Library, nine Departmental Libraries, and five Hostel Libraries. The Central Library is housed in the Administrative Block, spread over 1465 sq. m with a seating capacity of 344 users. It has KOHA Library Management Software, Web OPAC, Digital Library, DSpace Institutional Repository, and memberships to DELNET and National Digital Library. Library hours are 8:30 AM to 9:00 PM, extended till midnight during exams.

question: What are the library timings at AKGEC?
answer: The AKGEC Central Library is open from 8:30 AM to 9:00 PM on regular days. During examination periods, library hours are extended till 12:00 midnight. Books are issued from 8:45 AM to 3:45 PM only.

question: What are the library rules at AKGEC?
answer: UG students can borrow a maximum of 2 books at a time for 10 days, PG students can borrow 3 books. A fine of Rs. 10 per day per volume is charged for late returns. Personal belongings like bags are not allowed inside the library. Identity cards are non-transferable. Loss of identity card must be reported immediately.

question: What centres of excellence does AKGEC have?

question: Does AKGEC have a robotics training centre?
answer: Yes, AKGEC jointly with KUKA Robotics (India) has set up India's first Industrial Robotics Training Centre for Educational Institutions at AKGEC, Ghaziabad. It offers Basic, Advance, and Expert level training on Industrial Robotics with internationally recognized joint certification by KUKA Roboter, Germany and AKGEC.

question: What is the Faith Centre at AKGEC?
answer: The Faith Centre is a spiritual space at AKGEC dedicated to Maa Saraswati (Goddess of Knowledge). It features an approximately six-feet high white marble idol of Maa Saraswati, a dome architecturally similar to the Lotus Temple of Delhi, and sprinkling fountains. It serves as a place for spiritual and moral well-being for faculty, staff, and students.

question: Does AKGEC have a Fab Lab?

It is a product development and innovation center equipped with rapid prototyping tools, training kits, hardware and software for digital fabrication. It is open to undergraduates, postgraduates, and the local community of makers and innovators.

question: Does AKGEC have welding technology centre?

question: What is the library fine at AKGEC?
answer: AKGEC library fines include: Rs. 10 per day per volume for late return of general books, Rs. 20 per day for reference books returned late, Rs. 2 per hour for hourly issued materials, Rs. 1000 for misplacing, marking, or tearing books, and Rs. 2000 for stealing from the library.
